description: Ingredient-specific nutrition sources and measurement conversions. Each entry is UNVERIFIED until a human/editor has matched the ingredient, food composition source, usable edible grams per recipe unit, and prep state. No fake nutrient data is populated.
units: Nutrients per 100 g edible ingredient; gramsPerUnit keyed by the actual recipe unit.

Apple cider vinegar.portionSource: USDA explicit 1 tbsp = 14.9 g; food use/retention still must be reviewed.
Apple cider vinegar.reviewNotes: Source-linked ingredient INPUT mapping. Does not imply final recipe serving nutrition is verified; recipe-specific cooking retention and yield must be checked.

Chili powder.state: dry blended chili powder; not pure ground chile or fresh chili
Chili powder.reviewNotes: USDA chili powder BLEND; recipes using a different pure ground chile require reclassification. Per-serving totals may require cooked retained quantity review.

Crushed tomatoes.portionSource: USDA lists 0.5 cup = 121 g, scaled to 1 cup = 242g; oz interpreted as mass ounce not fluid ounce. Brands and drained liquid may vary.
Crushed tomatoes.reviewNotes: Source-linked ingredient INPUT mapping. Does not imply final recipe serving nutrition is verified; recipe-specific cooking retention and yield must be checked.

Garlic cloves.state: raw garlic clove, 3 g edible portion; input ingredient before cooking
Garlic cloves.portionSource: USDA FDC 169230 raw garlic 1 clove = 3g edible portion
Garlic cloves.reviewNotes: Ingredient composition verified at recipe input. Cooking moisture, garlic size variation and ingredient retention are not estimated; recipe totals remain unverified until all source mappings and yields have been reviewed.

Garlic powder.portionSource: USDA explicit 1 tsp = 3.1 g; dry garlic powder, not garlic salt.
Garlic powder.reviewNotes: Source-linked ingredient INPUT mapping. Does not imply final recipe serving nutrition is verified; recipe-specific cooking retention and yield must be checked.

Lime juice.state: raw expressed lime juice by measured volume; not whole lime wedges
Lime juice.portionSource: USDA 1 cup lime juice = 242g; 1 US tablespoon = 1/16 US cup, derived 15.125g
Lime juice.reviewNotes: Measured lime juice ingredient only. Does not resolve distinct whole-lime garnish uses or actual amounts retained in marinades.

Olive oil.state: olive oil as measured before cooking; absorption and discarded oil depend on recipe
Olive oil.reviewNotes: Source composition and USDA tablespoon measure verified; fraction consumed in dressings, marinades, and pans must be reviewed separately.
